tests.name: token_text_buffer_head_boundary
tests.intent: Verify that token_text_buffer correctly retains and outputs exact contents when the input length is precisely at the head limit.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_exceed_limit
tests.intent: Verify that token_text_buffer correctly truncates very long tokens, inserting an ellipsis in the error message.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_istream_adapter
tests.intent: Verify that std::istream parsing correctly utilizes the token buffer and does not leak memory or fail on huge whitespace sequences.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_list_iterator
tests.intent: Verify that input iterators like std::list<char>::iterator successfully build and truncate tokens via token_text_buffer.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_clear_reset
tests.intent: Verify that calling clear() or resetting tokens functions properly without leaving stale text in subsequent parse errors.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_pop_back_usage
tests.intent: Verify that pop_back works safely during token parsing contexts when backing off scanner state.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_small_token
tests.intent: Verify small tokens below the head limit do not exhibit any truncation ellipses.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_exact_eight_thousand
tests.intent: Verify behavior right around the 8192 total token length boundary.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_control_chars
tests.intent: Verify that control characters inside long tokens are safely escaped in parse error strings.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_move_semantics
tests.intent: Verify that token text buffer move constructor and move assignment compile and operate correctly.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_file_adapter
tests.intent: Verify file stream adapter input parsing behavior with long token scenarios using tmpfile.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_multiple_resets
tests.intent: Verify token text buffer handles multiple string and number resets correctly without state corruption.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_empty_input
tests.intent: Verify empty input handling does not invoke token text buffer error paths improperly.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_huge_string_literal
tests.intent: Verify handling of excessively long string literals alongside token text buffer constraints.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_deep_nesting
tests.intent: Verify deep array nesting combined with long tokens does not disrupt buffer tracking.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_stream_wchar
tests.intent: Verify parser behavior or standard types when handling stream parsing features.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_append_pieces
tests.intent: Verify chunked appending logic through large piecewise data inputs.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_ordered_json
tests.intent: Verify ordered_json parser integration with the updated lexer token text buffer.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_sax_interface
tests.intent: Verify SAX parser consumer interface works seamlessly with long input tokens.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_capacity_limit_check
tests.intent: Verify that capacity strictly respects limits and never exceeds maximum allowed threshold during extensive token scanning.
